## Download

Grab **`MandoPC.exe`** below, run it on your Windows PC and scan the QR code with your phone. No install needed on the phone.

> **"Windows protected your PC"?** The app isn't signed with a paid certificate yet. Click **More info → Run anyway**. The full source is in this repository.

## What's in 1.0

- **Trackpad** with natural gestures, inertia and an adjustable size (left or right side in landscape).
- **Window dial**: tap for Alt+Tab, hold and slide to flip through your open windows, with their icons sliding by.
- **Active app card**: real app icon, window controls and smart shortcuts for browsers, web video, Stremio, Spotify, PowerPoint, File Explorer and more.
- **Screen view**: see your PC on the phone, tap to click, hold for a magnifier.
- **Quick menu**: TV, volume slider with mute, show desktop, keyboard and power options.
- **TV section** with your streaming sites, editable with a long press.
- **Type from your phone** whenever a text field is active on the PC.
- **Cursor halo** to spot the mouse from across the room.
- **Interactive tutorial**, per-action haptics, dark and light (Frutiger Aero) themes, and a hidden one.
- **Tray icon** with QR code, start with Windows and automatic firewall setup.
